description:
Title: Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine

You develop an application that helps you with the inspection of a machine.
After entering the type of the machine, and its serial number, the inspection can begin:
* Questions are asked, and you have to input values.
* Buttons are to be pressed, and values are automatically collected from the machine and shown to you.
* Depending on the results, additional questions are asked (or not).
generated_bpmn_xml:
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_MachineInspection" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/machine-inspection">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MachineInspection" name="Inspection of an Energy Drink Bottling Machine" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_InspectionBegin" name="Inspection started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_EnterMachineType</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterMachineType" name="Enter machine type">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_EnterMachineType</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterMachineType_EnterSerialNumber</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_EnterSerialNumber" name="Enter serial number">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterMachineType_EnterSerialNumber</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_EnterSerialNumber_AnswerQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerQuestions" name="Answer inspection questions by entering values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_EnterSerialNumber_AnswerQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AnswerQuestions_PressButton</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_PressButton" name="Press inspection button">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AnswerQuestions_PressButton</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PressButton_CollectValues</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CollectMachineValues" name="Automatically collect and show machine values">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PressButton_CollectValues</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectValues_Split</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split" name="Are additional questions required depending on the results?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectValues_Split</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Split_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" name="Answer additional questions">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_AdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AdditionalQuestions_Merge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Merge" name="Inspection questions complete">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AdditionalQuestions_Merge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Split_NoAdditionalQuestions</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Merge_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted" name="Inspection completed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Merge_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_EnterMachineType" sourceRef="StartEvent_InspectionBegin" targetRef="Task_EnterMachineType"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterMachineType_EnterSerialNumber" sourceRef="Task_EnterMachineType" targetRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_EnterSerialNumber_AnswerQuestions" sourceRef="Task_EnterSerialNumber" targetRef="Task_AnswerQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnswerQuestions_PressButton" sourceRef="Task_AnswerQuestions" targetRef="Task_PressButton"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PressButton_CollectValues" sourceRef="Task_PressButton" targetRef="Task_CollectMachineValues"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectValues_Split" sourceRef="Task_CollectMachineValues" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_AdditionalQuestions" name="Yes: additional questions required" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split" targetRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Split_NoAdditionalQuestions" name="No: no additional questions required" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Split" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AdditionalQuestions_Merge" sourceRef="Task_AnswerAdditionalQuestions" targetRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Merge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_End" sourceRef="Gateway_AdditionalQuestions_Merge" targetRef="EndEvent_InspectionCompleted"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
